messages:
Sam (AE): FYI Acme wants a short POC to validate a summarization + Q&A flow. They asked for success criteria, pricing, and security checklist. Can we draft a minimal eval plan today?
Leila (Solutions): +1. Key Qs: which intents to prioritize, what counts as "good enough" (exact thresholds), and do they need passthrough data retention disabled?
Emily (Acme): From our side: focus on customer support docs -> answer accuracy and hallucination rate are top. Timeline: 3 weeks. Budget: want estimate for a 3-week dedicated trial with ~100k tokens/day.
Raj (SE): For the eval harness I'd start with a golden set ~150 prompts across 3 intents: summary, extractive Q&A, and follow-up clarification. Scoring: combination of semantic similarity (embedding cosine) + human label for hallucination. Weighted score example: 0.6 semantic, 0.4 hallucination penalty.
Leila (Solutions): Example pass gate suggestion: golden-set weighted score >= 0.75 AND no more than 5% hallucination critical errors. Also measure latency p95 < 300ms for their 512-token avg.
Sam (AE): Pricing question from Emily: can we offer a short reserved capacity price or should we do hosted overage? They prefer predictability.
Raj (SE): For the harness infra: we can run Redwood hosted with an A/B between quantized+cache and full-precision model. Regression gates: if golden-set score drops by >3% vs baseline we block rollout. We'll collect token counts, model variant, and input lengths for drift analysis.
Emily (Acme): Security: they require BYOK + SOC2 evidence and data residency in eu-west. Any blockers?
SecurityBot: Checklist flags: BYOK supported for Private/Dedicated. Need to confirm encryption-at-rest key rotation policy and audit log retention > 90 days. Also ask for the completed vendor security questionnaire (see link) and optional pen test attestation.
Leila (Solutions): Operational plan: Week 0 = ingest corpus and seed golden prompts (we provide a template). Week 1 = initial run + manual review of 50 cases. Week 2 = tune prompts + run full golden set. Week 3 = final metrics, regression report, and recommendation.
Sam (AE): Can we commit an SE for setup + 2 dev hours to seed prompts? Acme expects quick turnaround.
Raj (SE): Yes, I can do the setup and help craft scoring script. Minimal harness snippet we'll use:
```
# pseudo-score
for resp in responses:
  sim = emb_cosine(resp, gold_ref)
  hall = detect_hallucination(resp)
  score = 0.6 * sim - 0.4 * hall
```
I'll push the script and instructions to the shared folder.
Emily (Acme): Sounds good. One more: for human review labels, we prefer a simple triage: correct / incorrect / unsafe. Can you map that to the numeric gate?
Leila (Solutions): Map: correct=0, incorrect=1, unsafe=1.5. Weighted hallucination penalty = average(label_score) normalized to [0,1]. We'll document mapping in the eval spec.
Ops: Heads-up — if they take Dedicated we need a small lead time for capacity (2-3 business days) and a billing commit for the trial.
Sam (AE): Action items: 1) Raj to drop harness script + template prompts (today). 2) Leila to write quick success criteria doc (tomorrow). 3) SecurityBot / Security to confirm BYOK + residency timeline (today). 4) I will send pricing/commit options to Emily.
Emily (Acme): Thanks everyone. If we can get the harness + initial run this week we'll keep the 3-week window. :thumbsup:
Leila (Solutions): Will do. Sending prompt template link in ~1h. :eyes:
Raj (SE): Pushing script now. I added a small sample of 20 golden prompts to get started.
SecurityBot: Uploaded SOC2 summary and BYOK integration doc to the shared drive.
Sam (AE): Great — will follow up after first run.
